AI-Powered Tuberculosis Detection at Scale

Closing the diagnosis gap in India's TB elimination mission.

ARTPARK's TB screening initiative builds AI tools to support the detection pipeline from chest X-ray triage to clinical confirmation.

Using deep learning models trained on Indian radiological data, the system helps flag high-risk cases for priority clinical review. The database on which the AI model is trained includes images from primary and secondary care facilities with varying image quality.

Features

Focus area: High-burden districts

Target users: Community-based screening programs at primary care level

AI modality: Chest X-ray analysis with Indian training data

Training data: Built on MIDAS - India-specific imaging datasets

Integration: Compatible with NIKSHAY National TB management system

Our Partners

National and state TB programs
